research.title: NCETM KS3: simplifying and manipulating expressions, equations and formulae
research.treatment: Understand quantities in a familiar situation before symbolic representation; reason about changing one variable.
research.adopted: Named physical quantities and controlled comparison before any formal function notation.
research.rejected: No symbolic manipulation as an entry requirement.
research.usageRestrictions: Crown copyright2019/2021; professional-development reference, not a lesson to lift. No text or figures copied.
research.limitations: Conceptual design support, not evidence of efficacy or Finnish curriculum approval.

research.title: Fill Me Up
research.treatment: Compare prediction, container geometry and an actual filling experiment.
research.adopted: A stated constant-cross-section vessel and original controlled filling model, with a concrete experimental alternative.
research.rejected: Do not make graph sketching a prerequisite of recognizing dependence; do not assume equal height change for every vessel.
research.usageRestrictions: Reference only; no source figures/prose embedded. Redistribution permission not inferred.
research.limitations: Age11–14 comparable task, not a validation of this lesson; our task isolates two quantities rather than graphing.

inventory.intro: Dependency defined using one quantity changing another.
inventory.demo: dependScene bucket k litres/minute and weekday/100°C comparator under same clock; verbal change-one test.
inventory.generators: DEP_PAIRS binary contextual choices; which-variable choice; y=kx+b differences; dependency sorting.
inventory.transfer: Water k litres/minute extended beyond given0..3 table; numeric k*n.
inventory.hint: Imagine first quantity changing; subtraction of adjacent y-values or given unit-rate multiplication.
inventory.feedback: Per-pair rationale, numeric whyAt for addition/interval/off-by-one.
inventory.media: dependScene synchronized bucket/table and weekday/pot comparison.
inventory.audit: Reports dependency animation/sort correction; treated as unapproved reference, not acceptance.

alignment.inherited: Water-flow context, paired quantities, directions and teacher-supported transfer.
alignment.extended: Explicit draining/decreasing case, fixed physical container height and limits0..4min; cost with nonzero fixed fee.
alignment.corrected: No unconditional100°C claim, no weekday clock pretending to advance days under minutes. Declining or locally unchanged relations are not denied. No arithmetic transfer mistaken for recognition of dependence.

currentSource.scope: Current Lite source bytes; sourceFiles/sourceHashes outside currentSource remain historical supplied-snapshot provenance.
currentSource.reviewBoundary: Source binding only. Current content/alignment decisions and technical evidence are separate; teacher and learner validation remain pending.

planning.childGoal: Tunnistan, mikä muuttuu ja miten suureet liittyvät toisiinsa.
planning.assumed: Reading small0..20 quantities and meanings of time, litres, length are assumed or supported. No coordinate plotting or variable notation required; all unit-rate results displayed.
coTaught: M-MULTAB-LOW (optional repeated2 litres; no independent arithmetic credit)
planning.scope: Given controlled deterministic models, increasing/decreasing/constant comparisons and transfer; not general empirical causation or formal function definition.
planning.evidenceLimits: Low-stakes directional feedback, no stored learner evidence or independent mastery/retention certification.
planning.assetProvenance: Original SVG and simulation; supplied unchanged v2 Loikka raster reinterpretation. Public licensing holds retained.
